messages:
From: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ukc.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2028 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: SOC 2 renewal — timeline and bulk evidence staging

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the heads up on renewal notices. Our contract with Redwood is up for renewal Nov 15 and part of our procurement checklist is the SOC 2 re-attestation. We want to avoid any last-minute surprises — can you outline:

- a minimal evidence list you need for re-attestation (logs, configs, attestation artifacts)
- recommended cadence for uploading evidence (bulk handoff vs. staged uploads)
- whether Redwood can support a short trial burst (30M tokens/day) for end-of-quarter load testing while the new term is negotiated

We have an internal auditor joining next week and would like to provide a mutual action plan by Oct 10.

Attached is an initial mapping we pulled together — it’s a flat inventory and notes on where we expect logs to come from.

Best,
Marta
Ops & Compliance | UKC Analytics
[Attachment: UKC_SOC2_Evidence_Map_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ukc.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2028 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — timeline and bulk evidence staging

Hi Marta — thanks for the map and the clear asks. High-level roadmap and answers below; I’ll pull Ben and Kim in for pricing/SLA and to confirm seat/term options.

1) Minimal evidence set (what we typically need for SOC 2 recert):
   - Authentication/access logs (30/90 day slices depending on scope)
   - Model deployment change log and version manifest
   - Incident and PagerDuty/ops postmortems for the past 12 months (redacted where needed)
   - Config snapshots (network, KMS access lists)
   - Signed attestation letters where customers rely on subservice orgs

2) Upload cadence recommendation:
   - Bulk handoff for historical artifacts (we can accept a single bulk transfer to a secure Drive link)
   - Staged uploads for rolling items (logs and releases): weekly batches for 30-day windows, final 90-day consolidated package 10 days before audit start

3) Short-term burst: we can provision a 30M tokens/day trial for up to 14 days against a Dedicated burst pool while the deal is negotiated. We’ll need a short written MOU and authorization from procurement for cost exposure.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to provide provisional pricing/term amendment for seat uplift & short burst
- Kim to confirm SLA amendment language and whether a temporary log retention extension is billable
- I’ll coordinate evidence ingestion with Priyom (cc’d) and share a secure folder link for bulk transfer.

I’m available for a 30-minute call Thu Oct 5 11:00-11:30 CET if that works for your auditor.

La u ren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Lauren and Marta — looping in commercial details.

Marta — quick notes on the commercial path to support the asks:
- Seat uplift: we can offer +15 seats on current term at a 12% list uplift pro-rated through Nov 14, rollover to standard pricing at renewal.
- Short-term burst: we’ll enable a 14-day burst window. Cost exposure capped at $7,500 for the trial; if usage exceeds that we’ll pause and notify.
- Term amendment: we can include a one-time log retention extension to 18 months for SOC 2 evidence delivery (billable) or a 90-day complimentary extension if the renewal signs by Nov 1.

I’ll prepare a one-page amendment (DocuSign link below) for signature and a HubSpot deal update so finance can provision the trial bucket. If you want, we can attach the amendment to your renewal PO to make procurement easier.

DocuSign (provisional amendment): https://docusign.redwood.com/amendments/DL-9842
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/DL-9842

If this looks good I’ll move to get the amendment into routing today and ask Finance to provision the burst pool.

-Ben

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ivanova <marta.ivanova@ukc.io>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2028 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Evidence staging playbook and upload instructions

Hi Marta — welcome, and thanks for sharing the initial inventory. I’m the evidence lead on this and will own the staging pipeline. A few operational notes and the ingest plan:

1) Secure upload options:
   - SFTP: we can provide one-time creds scoped to the evidence folder (preferred for large bulk transfers).
   - Secure Drive link: we’ll share a Drive folder and I’ll perform an initial checksum pass on arrival.

2) Naming/manifest convention (please follow these exactly):
   - <UKC>_<artifact-type>_<YYYYMMDD>_<version>.ext  (e.g., UKC_authlogs_20280930_v1.csv)

3) Log windows we need for re-attest:
   - Primary: 90-day rolling window (production access logs)
   - Supplementary: last 12 months incident timeline (PDFs)

4) Timeline:
   - Bulk handoff accepted by Oct 11 for historical artifacts
   - Weekly incremental uploads starting Oct 12 through Nov 4
   - Final consolidated package by Nov 5

5) Next steps for the burst request:
   - Marta: please confirm a technical contact for traffic shaping during the trial
   - Ben: once amendment is signed, Finance will provision the burst pool and I’ll send network ACLs to allow the test endpoints

I’ll post the SFTP details to the secure Drive link and share a short checklist. If you prefer a call, I’m free Tue Oct 9 09:00-10:00 CET.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Evidence Orchestration Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
